blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton
blocks.intro: Fix it without tearing out tile when possible.

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.body: Scale from Elmhurst's water builds up in showerheads and valve cartridges. A showerhead that sprays sideways can often be cleaned by soaking it in vinegar. A valve that drips or is hard to turn usually has a worn cartridge. We carry common cartridges and can find most others. If the valve is very old, replacing it with a pressure-balancing valve fixes temperature swings too.

blocks.h2: Shower Repairs in Mid-Century Elmhurst Baths
blocks.body: Bathrooms in Elmhurst homes from the 1950s and '60s often have a tiled tub and shower with a two- or three-handle valve. Those valves can usually be rebuilt with new stems and washers. When they can't, a single-handle pressure-balancing valve is the upgrade. We work through the existing opening and cover the old holes with a trim plate, so most of the tile stays intact.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Shower Repair
blocks.body: A cartridge or washer replacement is usually a short visit. Replacing the whole valve takes longer, especially if access means working through tile. A leak below the shower can be the valve, the drain or the pan, and testing finds which. We diagnose first and quote one flat price before any work.

items.q: Why is my shower spray weak?
items.preview: Scale in the head or valve.
items.answer: Usually mineral scale in the showerhead or valve screen. Cleaning or replacing them restores flow.

items.q: Why does my shower get hot when someone flushes?
items.answer: Older valves don't balance pressure. A new pressure-balancing valve fixes it.

items.q: Can you fix a drip without opening the wall?
items.answer: Usually, by replacing the cartridge or washers through the trim.

items.q: Can you replace an old three-handle valve?
items.answer: Yes, with a single-handle valve and a trim plate that covers the old holes.

items.q: Can you replace a showerhead with a rain head?
items.answer: Yes, if the supply and arm can support it.

items.q: Why does my shower drain slowly?
items.answer: Usually hair and soap in the trap. We clear it and check the line beyond it.
